newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli President Weizman breaks wrist, hip.
newsitem.headline: Israeli President Weizman breaks wrist, hip.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman broke his wrist and hip on Friday, Israeli security sources and hospital officials said.
Security sources said the 72-year-old president tripped when he was disembarking from a helicopter on his return to his home in the northern Israeli town of Caesarea.
The president had just visited Israeli schoolgirls wounded in a shooting attack by a Jordanian soldier on Thursday. Seven girls were killed in the incident.
Spokeswoman Anat Baram at Hillel Yaffe hospital in the northern Israeli town of Hadera, where Weizman was taken for initial treatment, said he had broken his hip and wrist.
She said he would move shortly to Jerusalem's Hadassah Medical Centre.
